claim.claim-text: 2. The display device of claim 1, wherein the first common layer is a hole transporting layer and the second common layer is an electron transporting layer.
3. The display device of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the first and second common layers are disposed on a side surface of the plurality of spacers.
4. The display device of any preceding claim, wherein the second common layer on the side surface of the plurality of spacers contacts the first encapsulation layer.
5. The display device of any preceding claim, further comprising:
6. The display device of claim 5, wherein the first substrate includes a foldable plastic.
7. The display device of claim 5 or claim 6, wherein the buffer layer has a single layer or a multiple layer of silicon oxide or silicon nitride.
8. The display device of any of claims 5-7, wherein a semiconductor layer of the thin film transistor includes a polycrystalline semiconductor material and an oxide semiconductor material.
9. The display device of any of claims 5-8, wherein the bank layer includes polyimide or photoresist and/or has a same material as the plurality of spacers.
10. The display device of any of claims 5-9, wherein the cathode includes a transparent conductive material.
11. The display device of any of claims 5-10, wherein bottom shield metal layer has a single layer or a multiple layer of titanium or molybdenum, or an alloy of titanium or molybdenum.

12. The display device of any previous claim, wherein each of the plurality of spacers has a reverse taper shape, wherein the first and second common layers extend to an adjacent subpixel through side and top surfaces of each of the plurality of spacers.

13. The display device of any previous claim, wherein the plurality of spacers are spaced apart from each other in the periphery of the one of the first, second and third subpixels to surround the one of the first, second and third subpixels.
14. The display device of claim 13, wherein each of the plurality of spacers includes a plurality of sub-spacers (154a, 154b) spaced apart from each other.
15. The display device according to any preceding claim, wherein the plurality of spacers includes a same material as the bank layer.
